descFull: Agent OS: Stop prompting. Start specifying. A Socratic interview gates the spec on an ambiguity score, then one command drives execution, a staged evaluation gate, and a budgeted evolution loop that runs the semantic stage only. MCP server, 13 runtimes: Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, Copilot, Kiro and more.
